title: A kb-content gate whose do or host_check command writes to a forge, or whose url path names a release, is no longer classed push
goal: SP-aoiqmnc6 review G1+G2 (BG-e3o47d6s): without_vendor_names blanks GitLab, GitHub and their host names in the whole gate text, its do and host_check command words included, and VENDOR_HOST swallows the url path after the host, so on an item whose touches all lie under kb/ a do command `curl -X POST https://gitlab.com/api/v4/.../tags`, a `gh pr merge 12 --repo github`, a host_check reading github.com/org/repo/releases/1 and a question naming github.com/org/repo/releases/download/v1 all class design, against gate g1's answer that release and the push verbs keep the class. The vendor names are blanked only in a gate's question and options, never in its do and host_check command words, and a host name is blanked without the url path after it, so each of those gates stays push while the vendor-name gates of BG-e3o47d6s stay design.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a
kb={'touches':['kb/public/gitlab/x.md']}
def c(q,**k):
    g=dict(id='g1',question=q,options=['yes','no'],**k);return a.class_reasons(kb,g)[0]
r=dict(do_curl=c('Create the tag now?',do={'yes':['curl','-X','POST','https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/1/repository/tags']}),
       do_gh=c('Go?',do={'yes':['gh','pr','merge','12','--repo','github']}),
       host_release=c('Go?',host_check=['curl','-sf','https://github.com/org/repo/releases/1']),
       url_release=c('Is the asset at github.com/org/repo/releases/download/v1?'),
       vendor_ok=c('Which GitLab doc row stays?'))
print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(v=='push' for k,v in r.items() if k!='vendor_ok') and r['vendor_ok']=='design' else 1)

notes: Filed 2026-10-17 by the SP-aoiqmnc6 review (reviewer graded S2; the orchestrator, acting for the operator, files it S1 because it lowers the push class, an operator-authority guard, against BG-e3o47d6s g1's answer). Premise on 098946887: the repro exits 1 (do_curl, do_gh, host_release, url_release all design). 'tag' was never a push word: a question naming only a tag is out of scope. No new test.
